description: This file defines an Angular service class 'JournalEntryService' that provides methods to perform CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) on journal entries via HTTP requests to a backend API. The service interacts with the 'JournalEntry' model and uses Angular dependency injection and RxJS for asynchronous handling.

classes.name: JournalEntryService
classes.description: Angular service class managing CRUD operations for journal entries via HTTP.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all journal entries from the backend API.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific journal entry by its ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new journal entry on the backend.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing journal entry identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a journal entry by ID.
